grant_name: Innovate UK Smart Grants — November 2024 round

approval.notes: All six sections accepted as edited; final patches applied 2026-06-08 — Q4 C17 ScienceDirect title restored, Q6 Sheffield conversion-clause sentence added, Q7 DESNZ peak/off-peak worked example replaces earlier ~120 t with ~257 t per deployment, Q9 finance closeouts (salary bands, AE scope, £40k split, Okafor PM reconciliation). Cross-application read-through required as final pipeline step.

eligibility: SME — the 45% experimental development rate is the SME rate, so SME status is implied as the intended applicant profile
Project duration must fall within 6–18 months (single) or 19–24 months (collaborative); anything outside these bounds is ineligible
Project total cost must fall within the stated funding bands (£100k–£500k single, up to £1m collaborative)
NOTE: brief does not explicitly state UK-registration, lead-applicant, or sector restrictions — standard Innovate UK Smart Grant rules likely apply but are not in the supplied text

sections.name: Q4 — Your idea and innovation
key_requirements: Idea is different from and ahead of already-available solutions (state of art comparison)
red_flags: Failing to differentiate from existing solutions

sections.name: Q5 — Justification for funding
key_requirements: Evidence the applicant has researched the match between their needs and Smart grant readiness
Clear counterfactual: what happens to the project without this funding
red_flags: No counterfactual — implying the project would proceed unchanged without funding
Treating the grant as topping up routine company spend rather than enabling specific R&D

sections.name: Q6 — Target market and commercialisation
key_requirements: Target market and customer base clearly researched and defined
red_flags: Vague or oversized TAM with no segmentation

sections.name: Q7 — Impact and benefits
key_requirements: Considerable positive impact for the organisations involved AND the wider economy
Coverage of jobs, market share, productivity
Coverage of societal and environmental impact
red_flags: Impact stated only at company level with no wider economic story
Unsupported numerical claims (jobs, market share) with no methodology

sections.name: Q8 — Delivering your project
sections.appendix: 2-page project plan PDF + 2-page risk register PDF
key_requirements: Strong and capable team with capacity to deliver complex R&D
Realistic plans with explicit mitigation strategies
Project plan PDF and risk register PDF attached
red_flags: Team lacks named individuals or credentials for the work

sections.name: Q9 — Value for money
key_requirements: Costs are commensurate with the work being carried out
Evidence of how best value for money has been calculated
red_flags: No quotation comparison on subcontracted or capital items where relevant
Disproportionate allocation to overheads or non-R&D activity

evidence_needed: Counterfactual narrative — what happens without funding (Q5)
Match between company stage and Smart grant readiness (Q5)
Defined customer segments and route to market (Q6)
Quantified jobs / productivity / market-share impact with methodology (Q7)
Team CVs / named individuals with relevant credentials (Q8)
Cost breakdown by work package and cost category (Q9)
disqualifiers: NOTE: brief does not explicitly list disqualifiers. Standard Innovate UK rules likely apply (retrospective costs ineligible, work must not have started, mandatory attachments must be present) but are not stated in the supplied text — flag to user before submission.
